title: Node missing-parent infrastructure correction for the B52-D12 fresh holdout

cause.condition: the output array directory and its immediate parent cell directory were both absent
cause.effect: Node exited with ENOENT before producing arrays or a success report

allowedChanges.basis: exact byte copy of scripts/reconstruct-b52-d12-subpixel.mjs before correction
allowedChanges.semanticDelta: replace exactly one occurrence of fs.mkdirSync(args['output-dir'], { recursive: false }); with fs.mkdirSync(args['output-dir'], { recursive: true });
add a zero-render contract invocation where neither the reconstructor cell parent nor arrays directory exists; require Node success and Python/Node byte identity
route Node cells to the corrected tool, route every output to the new C1 root, bind correction provenance and otherwise preserve the original 65-process matrix
verify correction identity, exact allowed delta, unchanged frozen tools, missing-parent contract, zero-render Blender probes, new-root freshness and disk admission

forbiddenChanges: scientific spec bytes, fixtures, transforms, lens, sensor, resolution or generated material
projection oracle, Vector sign convention, bilinear kernel, tap order or arithmetic
owner, alpha, boundary, current-depth or transform-predicted previous-depth validity rules
thresholds, controls, base failure order, attacks, diagnostics or decision rule
Blender, Python, Node or OCIO runtime identities
any original D12 formal tool, preflight receipt, failed-root file or report
resume, copy, hard-link, symlink or measurement reuse from the invalid D12 root
selection or tuning based on partial invalid-run measurements

execution.rootPolicy: new root must be absent at preregistration, correction-tool freeze and preflight; create once and never overwrite
execution.inputPolicy: all source EXRs, adapter arrays, reconstructions, encoded EXRs and bridge EXRs must be created inside the new C1 root

preflightRequirements: correction spec and scientific spec hashes match
invalid root and failure receipt remain byte-identical
new formal root and C1 preflight root are absent
corrected Node source differs from the original by exactly the registered mkdir recursive flag
every unchanged scientific tool matches its blob at the original tool freeze commit
every C1 tool and test matches its blob at the C1 tool freeze commit
the missing-parent contract passes without Blender renders
source and bridge Blender API probes execute with zero renders
projected write leaves at least the unchanged 100 GiB reserve

decision.infrastructureValidity: VALID only if the complete fresh 65-child matrix succeeds and the inherited independent audit passes
decision.scientificVerdictAuthority: only the unchanged B52-D12 analyzer and audit may produce SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED from new-root evidence
decision.failurePolicy: retain any new failure as another invalid correction attempt; do not patch or resume it in place
